## readin busted evolharvester results (R)

```{r}

##readin busted evolharvester results
busted_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_bustedEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 

##readin meme evolharvester results
meme_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_memeEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 

##readin fel evolharvester results
fel_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_felEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## readin fubar evolharvester results
fubar_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_fubarEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 

## readin gard evolharvester results
gard_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_gardEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 

## readin absrel evolharvester results 
absrelp1_res <- read.csv("../fmo1_absrelp1EH.csv") 

```

## readin busted evolharvester results (as pandas df)

```{python}

import pandas as pd

##readin fel evolharvester results as pd df
fel_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_felEH.csv')

##readin gard evolharvester results as pd df
gard_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_gardEH.csv')

##readin meme evolharvester results as pd df
meme_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_memeEH.csv')

##readin fubar evolharvester results as pd df
fubar_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_fubarEH.csv')

##readin busted evolharvester results as pd df
busted_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_bustedEH.csv')

##readin absrel evolharvester results as pd df
absrel_pd = pd.read_csv('../fmo1_absrelp1EH.csv')

```
